articles.summary: SEC Declares Merger Registration Statement Effective; Company Announces 1-for-25 Reverse Stock Split Odyssey Marine Exploration, Inc. (NASDAQ: OMEX) (“Odyssey” or the “Company”), an ocean exploration and marine mineral development company, today announced that the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (the “SEC”) declared effective on October 15, 2026 its registration statement on Form S-4 relating to the proposed merger with American Ocean Minerals Corporation (“AOMC”). The Company plans to hold a special meeting of stockholders on December 2, 2026, to vote on proposals related to the merger. The Company also announced that it will effect a 1-for-25 reverse stock split of its common stock on October 29, 2026. Following the reverse stock split, Odyssey's common stock will continue to trade on The Nasdaq Capital Market under the symbol “OMEX” and under a new CUSIP number 676118300.
